title: WNBA Navigation V2 Step 7 — Production Speed Proof + Final Freeze
scope: Final navigation-transport overlay plus post-merge public production certification over byte-frozen Steps 1-6.

evidence: Open Game Center click did not reach the game page inside the 24 second budget
root_cause.cause: Frozen Step 5 runs selected-destination prefetch synchronously inside the native Streamlit button callback before the navigation rerun can complete. Public production can therefore remain visibly on Slate while destination work blocks the handoff.
root_cause.patch: Step 7 overrides only WNBA PRA navigation callbacks. It commits selected game/player plus navigation state immediately and defers destination work to the frozen destination render. Steps 1-6 source files remain byte-identical.

freeze_sequence: public Slate -> Game -> Player -> Back speed proof GREEN

product_evidence: public body rendered WNBA GAME CENTER
public body rendered GAME CENTER READY
public body rendered player PRA buttons
verifier_closeout.verifier_root_cause: The public verifier required Step-5/6/7 hidden page markers to agree before accepting Game/Player readiness. Streamlit can complete the user-visible destination surface while lower-layer hidden markers lag during the rerun, creating a false timeout after the product is already ready.
verifier_closeout.verifier_patch: Keep the Step-7 deployment marker required on Slate entry. Certify deeper route readiness from the actual interactive user-visible contract: Game Center heading + Back button + PRA buttons, and Player Intelligence heading + Back button.

product_evidence: public body rendered WNBA PRA INTELLIGENCE
public body rendered Minutes, Role, Usage + Availability
public body rendered Same-Opponent H2H Context
player_verifier_closeout.verifier_root_cause: Player readiness and final-surface assertions were case-sensitive while the live visual contract renders key headings in uppercase.
player_verifier_closeout.verifier_patch: Use case-insensitive semantic checks for Player Intelligence readiness and required final surfaces.

semantic_lazy_closeout.verifier_root_cause: The cert required two exact user-facing lazy-loading strings even though the frozen Slate semantics were already provable from route controls and absence of deeper heavy surfaces.
semantic_lazy_closeout.verifier_patch: Require a Slate game drill-down control, require Game/Player heavy DOM surfaces to remain absent before selection, and fail if deeper-route headings appear before explicit selection.
